006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.function;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.ITemporalItem;
009
010/**
011 * An {@link IMapItem} key based on an {@link ITemporalItem} value.
012 */
013public interface ITemporalMapKey extends IMapKey {
014
015  @Override
016  ITemporalItem getKey();
017
018  @Override
019  @SuppressWarnings("PMD.OnlyOneReturn")
020  default boolean isSameKey(IMapKey other) {
021    if (!(other instanceof ITemporalMapKey)) {
022      return false;
023    }
024
025    ITemporalItem thisTemporal = getKey();
026    ITemporalItem otherTemporal = ((ITemporalMapKey) other).getKey();
027    return thisTemporal.hasTimezone() == otherTemporal.hasTimezone()
028        && thisTemporal.deepEquals(otherTemporal);
029  }
030}
